head.t: Ascensia announces strategic partnership with Sava for innovative microsensor technology
head.x: A new wearable microsensor designed to make glucose monitoring less invasive could be available in Europe within the next two years, following a partnership between Ascensia Diabetes Care and Sava Technologies.

head.t: Quality of life after mastectomy alone compared with subpectoral breast reconstruction using the BREAST-Q and RAND-36
head.x: Mastectomy can negatively affect health-related quality of life (HR-QoL). Subpectoral breast reconstruction can be performed to restore breast contour and may improve HR-QoL. This study aimed to evaluate the long-term impact of mastectomy alone compared with subpectoral breast reconstruction.
head.s: Journal of Plastic, Reconstructive & Aesthetic Surgery
